+title: ElicitationURLConsentView and AuthorizationView on AuthorizationPresenter (plan §12, §13.3)
+---
+## What
+Create `Sources/AgentViewKit/Elicitation/ElicitationURLConsentView.swift`, `Sources/AgentViewKit/Connections/AuthorizationView.swift`, and `URLDisplay.swift`, per plan.md §12 and §13.3.
+
+- `URLDisplay.highlighted(_ url: URL) -> AttributedString`: the full URL with the host in bold; a warning flag when the host contains Punycode (`xn--`) or mixed scripts.
+- `ElicitationURLConsentView(request:)`: shows the server, the message, and the highlighted URL. Never auto-opens or pre-fetches. "Open in browser" calls `AuthorizationPresenter.present` and then `respond(to:_:)` with `.accept(nil)`. Shows a waiting state until the request is resolved by `elicitation/complete`, with Retry and Cancel always present. Cancel sends `.cancel`.
+- `AuthorizationView(request:)`: the in-thread "Connect to <server>" card with the requested scopes and a `.glassProminent` Connect button that calls `AgentThreadActions.connect(_:)`. Shows `ConnectionStatusChip` for the server's current state from the ambient `ConnectionStore`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] The URL text shows the host in bold and a warning for an `xn--` host.
+- [ ] Nothing is opened until the user taps the button (verify with an injected presenter that records calls).
+- [ ] After the tap, `respond` receives `.accept(nil)` and the view shows the waiting state.
+- [ ] `AuthorizationView` calls `connect` on tap and shows the chip state.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Elicitation/URLDisplayTests.swift`.
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Elicitation/ElicitationURLConsentViewHostedTests.swift`.
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Connections/AuthorizationViewHostedTests.swift`.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter AgentViewKitTests` exits 0.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
